title: SENTRY_DSN points at a public host
explanation: The image environment sets SENTRY_DSN to a public host. Sentry SDKs read it automatically and send events there.

evidence.detail: image env SENTRY_DSN points at public host o1.ingest.sentry.io

fix: Unset SENTRY_DSN, or point it at a Sentry instance inside the enclave.
